text:
elaine: heads-up — just watched a dedicated rollout where enabling `route_by_affinity` for 20% of traffic caused a surprising spike in cross-shard misses and routing errors. not an outage but noisy.
aditya: ugh. can you paste the console link / timeline? what metrics spiked specifically?
elaine: https://console.redwood/inference/rollouts/9732
elaine: errors: cross_shard_404 up ~2.3x, avg latency for p99 increased ~120ms for that cohort. request entropy metric jumped too.
kevin: hmm are we sure it was the flag itself and not the quota shard boundaries? did the rollout change routing weights or cohort assignment logic?
aditya: from the rollout diff it toggled affinity + set a small preferred_shard hint. we also had a transient quota rebalance happening at the same time (k8s drain on one pool).
maria: sounds like a classic "cascade of changes" problem — affinity change + transient capacity shift = amplified effects. our telemetry didn't link the two events together though. logs only had separate traces.
kevin: proposal: add a lightweight "impact simulation" step in the console that evaluates dependent signal changes before activating a flag. e.g. simulate: cohort -> shard mapping delta, estimated QPS per shard, estimated cache miss increase.
elaine: yes. we should display an "estimated downstream delta" and a short list of dependent systems (quotas, caches, routing rules) with severity.
aditya: agree. minimal API sketch below for a simulation endpoint:

```
POST /internal/config/simulate
{
  "flag": "route_by_affinity",
  "change": {"enabled": true, "percent": 20},
  "context": {"time_window": "last_24h", "cohort_key": "user_id"}
}

response: 200
{
  "sim_id": "abc123",
  "estimated": {"shard_qps": {"shard-a": 5000, "shard-b": 1200}, "cache_miss_pct_delta": 0.04},
  "dependencies": ["quota-service", "kv-cache", "kvs-routing"],
  "notes": ["transient rebalance in last 30m likely to amplify impact"]
}
```

kevin: also need telemetry events so that when a rollout happens we automatically correlate with recent infra events (rebalances, pool drains). suggested event bunlde fields:
- rollout_id
- flag_name
- percent
- impacted_shards
- pre/post_metrics (p95_latency, error_rate, cache_miss)

maria: +1. please include sample keys so we can attribute by cohort and not just by route. current APM traces don't tag cohort consistently.
elaine: UX note: in the console rollout flow show a red/yellow/green risk bar computed from simulation; require a "safety ack" for anything red with a checkbox listing dependencies.
aditya: ops playbook idea: if simulation predicts >5% error_rate delta or >10% shard qps skew, auto-set rollout mode to "paused" with a canary webhook for manual proceed.
kevin: implementation nit: simulation should be fast and use sampled historical traces + our topology graph. don't run full replay for UI latency.
maria: who wants to own a small spike project to wire telemetry + simulate endpoint? I can take telemetry schema and console changes if someone pairs on the simulate API + model.
aditya: I can own the simulate API + naive estimator (historical window + capacity rules). will PR next week.
elaine: thanks — can we also add a small post-rollout audit that publishes the sim vs actual deltas to the rollout timeline for future learning?
kevin: yes, and hook that into the Optimize recommendations so repeated sims that were off get flagged for model improvements.
deploy-bot: rollout 9732 transitioned to PAUSED by manual ack @elaine :pause_button:
elaine: i'll open a short follow-up doc with simulation UX mock and telemetry schema. tagging @kevin @aditya @maria
kevin: :thumbsup:
